single_agent.description: One main agent may complete the mission and opportunistically use specialists when useful.

specialist_agents.description: Use specialist agents whenever they improve quality, speed, or coverage.

agent_team.description: Use a broader team when parallel work, independent validation, or domain separation genuinely helps.

escalation_triggers: mission naturally decomposes into independent work
specialists can improve reasoning or validation quality
the main agent judges broader coordination worthwhile
deescalation_triggers: the mission has converged to a narrow path
coordination adds more friction than value
non_negotiable_boundary: Do not damage the host machine or critical system areas.
